CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1577.

SHANGHAI, 23 May 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No D. 2702 Date 24 / 5 / 34）

Sir,

Further to my letter of 10 March 1932 No. 725 (your number D. 2702/1932) I have the honour to inform you that I am in receipt of a communication from Hongkong to the effect that Ludwig Adler, at the time suspected to be an agent of the Komintern, appears to employ tactics in commercial matters which almost amount to swindling.

In 1933 he received a consignement of goods from the "N.V. Electrotechn. Mechan. Industrie" at Utrecht (Holland) for an amount of £ 151.17.3, which soon after arrival was auctioned by his orders, without the proceeds being ever remitted to his principal.

He has left Hongkong for Europe, travelling probably via Siberia.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chinese Secretary.

（批：Reg / Attach file）

T. Robertson, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Special Branch,
SHANGHAI.

先生：

继我1932年3月10日第725号函（贵方编号 D. 2702/1932）之后，谨此告知，我方收到来自香港的消息，称路德维希·阿德勒（Ludwig Adler），当时被怀疑为共产国际代理人，其在商业事务中采用的手段几乎构成诈骗。

1933年，他收到来自乌得勒支（荷兰）“N.V. Electrotechn. Mechan. Industrie”公司的一批货物，价值151英镑17先令3便士，该批货物抵达后不久即按他的指令被拍卖，但所得款项从未汇给委托人。

他已离开香港前往欧洲，可能经由西伯利亚旅行。

此致
敬礼

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 725.

SHANGHAI, 10th March 1932 .

Sir,

Further to my letter No.567 of February 27th last,
I have the honour to forward herewith some additional
information regarding Ludwig Adler, emanating from the
Police at Vienna.

Ludwig Adler engaged in business in Shanghai from
1908 until 1911. He has since resided in London, Vienna,
the Netherlands and again in Vienna, from where he left
for China, returning to Vienna in 1926, where he founded a
trade-paper called "The Eastern Markets".

At present he is salesman for various firms to the
United States and the Far East.

At Chemnitz (Germany) an action was instituted against
him because of fraud, which action seems to be still pending.

The Vienna Police know nothing regarding his suspected
communist affiliations.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant

Chinese Secretary.

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

先生：

继我上月2月27日第567号函之后，谨此转呈来自维也纳警方关于路德维希·阿德勒的补充信息。

路德维希·阿德勒于1908年至1911年间在上海经商。此后他居住在伦敦、维也纳、荷兰，后又回到维也纳，并从那里前往中国，1926年返回维也纳，在那里创办了一份名为《东方市场》（The Eastern Markets）的商业刊物。

目前他是多家面向美国和远东公司的销售员。

在德国开姆尼茨（Chemnitz），曾因欺诈对他提起诉讼，该诉讼似乎仍在进行中。

维也纳警方对其涉嫌共产主义关联一事一无所知。

敬礼

VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 567.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / REGISTRY / S. D. D. 2702. / 29 2 32.）

SHANGHAI, 27 February 1932.

Sir,

With reference to Mr. Van den Berg's letter No. 3585
of October 22nd addressed to Mr. Aiers I have the honour
to forward herewith further particulars regarding Ludwig
Adler emanating from the authorities in the Netherlands.

Ludwig Adler was born at Mihalyur, province of Nyistia
(Hungary) on August 25th 1875. He is supposed to be a dealer
in foodstuffs. He was registered at Amsterdam, coming from
Vienna on October 20th 1915, together with his wife Melanie
Brüll, born at Vienna 5-12-1888 and their daughter Eleonore,
born at Westcliff (England) 6-11-1912.

On June 1919 Mrs. Adler and her daughter were again
registered after an absence of nine months, coming from
Vienna.

Adler, at that time, was in possession of passport
No. 33838, issued by the Austrian Consulate at Amsterdam
on December 13th 1918 and visaed for the return voyage
on May 26th 1919.

On June 11th 1921 the whole family returned to Vienna
and their names were struck off the register. They have
not been registered in the Netherlands since.

Adler's new nationality is Czecho-Slowakian.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

（签名）

Chinese Secretary.

T.P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

上海，1932年2月27日。

先生：

关于 Van den Berg 先生去年10月22日致 Aiers 先生的第3585号信函，谨此转呈来自荷兰当局关于路德维希·阿德勒的进一步详情。

路德维希·阿德勒于1875年8月25日出生于匈牙利 Nyistia 省的 Mihalyur（音译）。据信他为食品经销商。他于1915年10月20日从维也纳抵达阿姆斯特丹时进行了登记，同行者有其妻子 Melanie Brüll，1888年12月5日出生于维也纳，以及他们的女儿 Eleonore，1912年11月6日出生于英国 Westcliff。

1919年6月，Adler 夫人及其女儿在缺席九个月后从维也纳归来，再次进行了登记。

当时，Adler 持有奥地利驻阿姆斯特丹领事馆于1918年12月13日签发的第33838号护照，并于1919年5月26日签证用于返程。

1921年6月11日，全家返回维也纳，其名字从登记册中注销。此后他们未在荷兰登记。

Adler 的新国籍为捷克斯洛伐克。

此致
敬礼

先生，

您的恭顺仆人，

（签名）

中文秘书。

T.P. Givens 先生，
特别科主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2708.
Date 18. 11. 31.

Translation of extract from French Police Daily
Intelligence Report dated November 17, 1931.

ACTIVITY OF AGENTS OF THE COMINTERN AND OF THE U.S.S.R.

Para.1. L. Adler in Hongkong

Supplementary to the information given in
our report of October 27, 1931, page 1, para.1, we
are informed that one named Ludwig Adler, suspected
to be an agent of the Third International, arrived
in Singapore from France on August 18, 1931. He
left that town for Hongkong on September 19 arriving
there on September 14. He resides at No.292 Prince
Edward Road, with his friend a certain Mr. Komor,
a businessman .

L. Adler travels in the capacity of a
representative of various commercial firms, and
neither at Singapore nor at Hongkong has he been the
subject of an unfavourable comment on the part of the
British Police.

L.Adler is in possession of Czechoslovakian
passport No. 7/378 issued in Shanghai on March 6, 1929.

翻译自1931年11月17日法国警察每日情报报告摘录。

共产国际及苏联代理人的活动

第1段. 香港的路德维希·阿德勒

作为对我方1931年10月27日报告第1页第1段所提供信息的补充，我们获悉，一名名为路德维希·阿德勒的人，被怀疑为第三国际代理人，于1931年8月18日从法国抵达新加坡。他于9月19日离开该地前往香港，于9月14日抵达（原文日期逻辑有误，照实译出）。他居住在太子道292号，与其友人、商人 Komor 先生同住。

L. Adler 以多家商业公司代表的身份旅行，无论在新加坡还是香港，英国警方均未对其有过不利评价。

L. Adler 持有1929年3月6日在上海签发的捷克斯洛伐克护照，号码为 7/378。

VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C°
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2702.
date 23. 10. 31.

SHANGHAI, 22nd October 1931.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that according to infor-
mation received Ludwig Adler, left Singapore on the 19th of
September by the s.s. "Kashmir" for Hongkong.

He seems to have abandoned his plans for a trip to Nether-
lands India "for business reasons".

He arrived in Hongkong on 24 September 1931 and stayed
at the Peninsula Hotel until the 26th of that month.

He registered at Police Headquarters in Hongkong of his
own accord on the 2nd of October, stating in conversation that
he was an old "China hand", who had been visiting the Far East
as a commercial traveller for the past 28 years.

He appears to represent the following concerns:

1. Messrs. T.A. Cockin, Ltd., Manufacturers of Asbestos goods
of Huddersfield, Yorkshire, England.

2. Messrs. Craye & Fils, Tapestry and furniture covering
manufacturers, of Roubaix, North France.

He also represents several small Czecho-Slovakian concerns.

It appears to be his intention to make Hongkong his business
headquarters in the near future and to rent an office there.

At the present time he is staying at 292 Prince Edward Road,
the residence of Mr. Komor of Messrs. Komor & Komor, who he
says, is a very old friend of his.

His presence in Hongkong so far has given no rise to
suspicions.

He is short and stout build, clean shaven, has a small
nose and a healthy complexion. He speaks almost faultless
English.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

R.C. Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,

SHANGHAI.
[Signature]
23/10/31.

上海，1931年10月22日。

先生：

谨此告知，根据收到的信息，路德维希·阿德勒于9月19日乘坐“克什米尔”号轮船离开新加坡前往香港。

他似乎因“业务原因”放弃了前往荷属东印度的计划。

他于1931年9月24日抵达香港，并入住半岛酒店直至当月26日。

他于10月2日主动向香港警察总局登记，并在谈话中自称是老“中国通”，过去28年一直以商业推销员身份访问远东。

他似乎代表以下机构：

1. 英国约克郡哈德斯菲尔德的 T.A. Cockin 有限公司，石棉制品制造商。

2. 法国北部鲁贝的 Craye & Fils 公司，挂毯和家具覆盖物制造商。

他还代表几家小型捷克斯洛伐克公司。

他似乎打算在不久的将来以香港为商业总部，并在那里租用办公室。

目前他住在太子道292号，即 Komor & Komor 公司的 Komor 先生住所，他说 Komor 先生是他的老朋友。

迄今为止，他在香港的存在并未引起怀疑。

他身材矮胖，面部光洁无胡须，鼻子小巧，面色健康。他能说几乎无误的英语。

此致
敬礼

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 280. SHANGHAI.
21st September 1931.

PERSONAL.

Dear Mr Robertson,

No. S. B. D. 2702.
Date 26 - 8 - 31.

August 26 31.

My dear Steptoe,

The following radio has been received by
the French Consular Authorities from Indo-China :-

"Ludvig ADLER, born at Gratemichal, Checco-Slovakia,
"on August 25th, 1878, resides usually in Vienna,
"Austria. Reported to be an important agent of
"the III International in China as well as in
"French and British colonies of the Pacific.
"Supposed to have resided in Shanghai in 1920-
"1922 and in 1927. Passed through Indo-China in
"1928. End 1928 - 1929 Moscow.
"Reported to have left Juan-les-Pins (France) on
"the 26th July 1931 for Genoa, from where he
"intends to proceed to Singapore.
"Description : Age about fifty, tall, hair light
"brown, rather thin, heavily built, clean shaven,
"small nose, 'American type'".

Yours sincerely,

H.N. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.
